interpretation: Logical reads count requests, including cached pages; they are not SSD NAND bytes.
OS process storage counters are separate accounting and do not certify SSD service bandwidth.
Host eval times include pending GPU and host synchronization; nested totals overlap and cannot be added.
Hypothetical required logical throughput holds bytes/final-token fixed; speculation and weight reuse may change that ratio, and the estimates are not measured gains.
This MoE run does not reread the entire 23.94 GB checkpoint per decoded token.
Unified CPU/GPU RAM is one shared physical pool; the OS, active applications, KV/recurrent state, tiles and packed caches all compete with weights.
